body:
GBM test10 - Minimal three-page workspace

Left: app routing and direct-connection lists. Center: globe, real connection state, node selection and connect action. Right: account, usage, renewal, refresh and sign out.

Removed the vertical detail page, bottom navigation, the three home shortcuts, and the old connection slogan. Globe rotation and zoom keep ownership of their gestures; swipe outside the globe or use the top page labels to change pages.

Removed the long license introduction and unavailable source button. Component copyright/license texts remain accessible through a compact account-footer entry, with full notices on request. Repository visibility is separate from third-party license terms.

Retains signed-out black-screen and private engine storage fixes. Version 5.5.12 (50512), release/AOT build with the existing signing certificate. 53 Flutter tests passed, including gestures, large text, light/dark login visibility and readable component notices. Three-page debug runtime screenshots and final APK cold-start checks are recorded locally. Physical phone, live payment and production VPN end-to-end checks are not claimed.

ARM64 is the phone build. Install over the current app; no data reset is needed. Legacy asset filenames remain for updater compatibility.
